# Spring Break 2027 | Springbreak.com

> Destinations, parties, concerts and tour packages for Spring Break 2027, with 2026 popularity ratings and 2027 announcements from the major college tour companies and festivals.

URL: https://springbreak.com/
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key 2027 dates

- Peak spring break window: 2027-03-06 to 2027-03-28. Easter is early in 2027 (Mar 28), so most college breaks fall between Mar 6 and Mar 28. (source: https://www.floridarambler.com/beaches/2026-spring-break-florida/)
- Miami Music Week: 2027-03-22 to 2027-03-28. A week of club and pool-party showcases across Miami and Miami Beach. Schedules not yet posted. (source: https://www.miamiandbeaches.com/events/miami-music-week-guide)
- Winter Music Conference: 2027-03-24 to 2027-03-26. Kimpton EPIC Hotel, Miami. (source: https://www.edmtunes.com/2026/06/winter-music-conference-announce-2027-dates/amp/)
- Ultra Music Festival (27th edition): 2027-03-26 to 2027-03-28. Bayfront Park, Miami. Phase 1 lineup announced; tickets on sale. (source: https://ultramusicfestival.com/tickets/miami/)
- Easter Sunday: 2027-03-28. Late-season breaks often key off Easter week.
- Gulf Coast Jam, Panama City Beach: 2027-06-03 to 2027-06-06. This country festival comes after spring break season. Headliners: Luke Bryan, Jason Aldean, Bailey Zimmerman, Zach Top. (source: https://www.ticketnews.com/2026/10/gulf-coast-jam-reveals-full-2027-lineup-led-by-luke-bryan-jason-aldean-and-zach-top)

## FAQ

### When is spring break 2027?

Most U.S. college spring breaks in 2027 fall between March 6 and March 28. Easter is March 28, 2027, so the season is early and compressed. Texas schools usually share one mid-March week.

### What are the most popular spring break destinations?

Based on our Spring Break 2026 popularity rating, the top destinations are Cancun (97/100), Punta Cana (90/100), Nassau / Bahamas (83/100), South Padre Island (80/100), Cabo San Lucas (80/100).

### When is Ultra Music Festival 2027?

Ultra Music Festival Miami runs March 26–28, 2027 at Bayfront Park, closing out Miami Music Week (March 22–28). Calvin Harris leads the Phase 1 lineup.

### Which tour companies offer Spring Break 2027 trips?

STS Travel (Cancun, Cabo, Punta Cana, Nassau, Montego Bay, Riviera Maya, Las Vegas and new Guanacaste, Costa Rica), StudentCity (Cancun, Punta Cana, Cabo, Nassau) and Inertia Tours (South Padre Island, Cancun, Cabo).

### What's new for Spring Break 2027?

STS Travel added Guanacaste, Costa Rica as an adventure-focused destination, and named Cancun, Cabo, Punta Cana and Nassau its top 2027 picks.

# Cancun Spring Break 2027 Guide

> The #1 international spring break destination. Cancun's Hotel Zone combines turquoise Caribbean beaches, all-inclusive resorts and a club strip with light shows, open bars and stage shows every night.

URL: https://springbreak.com/destinations/cancun.html
Location: Quintana Roo, Mexico
Updated: 2026-11-11
2027 status: confirmed for 2027

## Key facts

- Fly into: CUN
- Drinking age: 18
- Top 2027 operators: StudentCity, STS, Inertia

## 2026 popularity rating

Score: 97/100 (rank #1 of 21; visitation 4.5/5, search & social buzz 5/5, spring-break crowd 5/5; high confidence)

- 2.80M airport passengers in Mar 2026 (−4.6% YoY), with near-record flight days Mar 21 and Mar 29 (source: https://www.caribjournal.com/2026/04/07/cancun-air-traffic-decline-march/)
- #1 international spring break destination in Allianz's 1.3M-itinerary analysis (source: https://www.allianzworldwidepartners.com/media-center/press-releases/Allianz-Partners-reveals-travelers-are-ready-for-beaches-cities-and-peace-of-mind-this-spring-break.html)
- Top-searched international spring break spot in 13 states (source: https://upgradedpoints.com/news/top-searched-spring-break-locations-2026/)

## 2027 events and packages

- STS Travel trips (named a top 2027 destination): Mar 2027 [confirmed for 2027] (source: https://www.travelpulse.com/news/destinations/caribbean-dominates-top-destinations-for-spring-break-2027)
- Inertia Tours, 3 resort tiers: 2027 page live [confirmed for 2027] (source: https://www.inertiatours.com/cancun-spring-break-resorts)
- StudentCity Party Package events: TBA [TBA]

Tour operators: StudentCity, STS Travel, Inertia Tours

Note: Club open-bar nights are usually sold as a party package add-on.

## Where to stay

- All-inclusive Hotel Zone resorts are the norm. Grand Oasis Cancun is a long-time student headquarters.
- Tour operators sell packages with flights, hotel and transfers. Inertia offers three resort tiers.
- Condo rentals give more space and a kitchen for groups.

## Nightlife

- Coco Bongo: Las Vegas-style shows, acrobats and live acts. It's the essential night out.
- The City, Mandala, La Vaquita and Dady'O: the Hotel Zone club strip around KM 9.
- Señor Frog's, Carlos'n Charlie's and Margaritaville for drinks and contests.
- Mandala Beach: day and night beach parties.
- Tour-operator party programs (theme nights, express entry, open bar) are the best-attended events.

## Days out

- Day trips to Tulum, Chichén Itzá and Cozumel.
- Snorkeling and diving on the Mesoamerican Reef near Puerto Morelos.
- Catamaran and booze cruises to Isla Mujeres.

## Rules and tips

- Use official taxis or your hotel's transport, and agree on the fare first.
- Skip moped rentals. Damage disputes are common.
- Drink bottled water, and don't drink in public on the street.
- Enroll in the State Department's STEP program and check the Quintana Roo advisory.

## FAQ

### Is Cancun a good spring break destination for 2027?

Cancun scored 97/100 (#1 of 21, "Red-hot") in our Spring Break 2026 popularity rating, based on visitation, search buzz and college crowds. The #1 international spring break destination. Cancun's Hotel Zone combines turquoise Caribbean beaches, all-inclusive resorts and a club strip with light shows, open bars and stage shows every night.

### What airport do you fly into for Cancun?

Fly into CUN.

### What is the drinking age in Cancun?

The drinking age is 18.

### Which tour companies offer Spring Break 2027 trips to Cancun?

StudentCity, STS Travel, Inertia Tours offer trips to Cancun. Compare out-the-door prices, party packages and refund policies before booking.

### What's happening in Cancun for Spring Break 2027?

STS Travel trips (named a top 2027 destination) (Mar 2027); Inertia Tours, 3 resort tiers (2027 page live).

### When is spring break 2027?

Most college spring breaks in 2027 fall between March 6 and March 28. Easter is March 28, 2027, which makes the season early and compressed.

# Punta Cana Spring Break 2027 Guide

> White-sand Bávaro beaches, all-inclusive resorts and a nightclub inside a cave. Punta Cana was one of the most popular Caribbean picks in 2026, with the Dominican Republic setting a record for March visitors.

URL: https://springbreak.com/destinations/puntacana.html
Location: Dominican Republic, Caribbean
Updated: 2026-11-11
2027 status: confirmed for 2027

## Key facts

- Fly into: PUJ
- Drinking age: 18
- 2027 resorts (STS): Riu Republica, Barceló Bávaro

## 2026 popularity rating

Score: 90/100 (rank #2 of 21; visitation 5/5, search & social buzz 4.5/5, spring-break crowd 4/5; high confidence)

- Dominican Republic hit a record 1.31M visitors in Mar 2026, with ~612K flying into Punta Cana (source: https://dr1.com/news/2026/04/14/dominican-republic-welcomes-record-3-7-million-visitors-in-q1-2026/)
- Named a leading Caribbean spring break pick by Allianz (source: https://www.caribjournal.com/2026/03/18/aruba-punta-cana-nassau-spring-break/)
- Top international resort search in 12 states (source: https://upgradedpoints.com/news/top-searched-spring-break-locations-2026/)

## 2027 events and packages

- STS Travel trips (named a top 2027 destination): Mar 2027 [confirmed for 2027] (source: https://www.travelpulse.com/news/destinations/caribbean-dominates-top-destinations-for-spring-break-2027)
- StudentCity open-bar beach events: TBA [TBA]
- Fox World Travel, 7-night all-inclusive: Mar 21–28, 2027 · from $2,791 per person [confirmed for 2027] (source: https://www.foxworldtravel.com/vacation-type/spring-break-deals/)

Tour operators: STS Travel, StudentCity

## Where to stay

- Riu Republica: an adults-only all-inclusive that's a long-time student favorite.
- Barceló Bávaro Palace and Occidental Caribe, also on STS Travel's 2027 list.
- StudentCity includes transportation, beach events and open-bar parties.

## Nightlife

- Imagine: a nightclub built inside a natural cave.
- Oro (at Hard Rock): a high-energy resort club.
- Open-bar beach parties and themed club nights through tour operators.

## Days out

- Catamaran and booze cruises with snorkeling stops.
- Saona Island day trips.
- Buggy and ATV tours through the countryside.

## Tips

- A passport valid for your whole stay is required, and the DR's entry form is completed online (e-Ticket).
- Stick to resort or licensed transportation, and keep valuables in the room safe.

## FAQ

### Is Punta Cana a good spring break destination for 2027?

White-sand Bávaro beaches, all-inclusive resorts and a nightclub inside a cave. Punta Cana was one of the most popular Caribbean picks in 2026, with the Dominican Republic setting a record for March visitors.

### What airport do you fly into for Punta Cana?

Fly into PUJ.

### What is the drinking age in Punta Cana?

The drinking age is 18.

### Which tour companies offer Spring Break 2027 trips to Punta Cana?

STS Travel, StudentCity offer trips to Punta Cana. Compare out-the-door prices, party packages and refund policies before booking.

### What's happening in Punta Cana for Spring Break 2027?

STS Travel trips (named a top 2027 destination) (Mar 2027); Fox World Travel, 7-night all-inclusive (Mar 21–28, 2027 · from $2,791 per person).

# Nassau / Bahamas Spring Break 2027 Guide

> A short flight from the U.S. East Coast with pirate history, Paradise Island's mega-resort and party cruises. The Bahamas set a record with about 1.42 million visitors in March 2026.

URL: https://springbreak.com/destinations/nassau.html
Location: Bahamas, Caribbean
Updated: 2026-11-11
2027 status: confirmed for 2027

## Key facts

- Fly into: NAS
- Drinking age: 18
- Money: Bahamian $ = US $ (USD accepted)

## 2026 popularity rating

Score: 83/100 (rank #3 of 21; visitation 5/5, search & social buzz 3.5/5, spring-break crowd 4/5; high confidence)

- Bahamas arrivals rose 15.7% to a record ~1.42M in Mar 2026 (source: https://www.centralbankbahamas.com/news/general-news/monthly-economic-and-financial-developments-mefd-march-2026-1)
- Named a leading Caribbean spring break pick by Allianz (source: https://www.caribjournal.com/2026/03/18/aruba-punta-cana-nassau-spring-break/)
- STS ran a month-long Bahamas Beach Bash for college groups (source: https://www.travelpulse.com/news/destinations/caribbean-dominates-top-destinations-for-spring-break-2027)

## 2027 events and packages

- STS Travel Nassau trips (start early March): Mar 2027 [confirmed for 2027] (source: https://www.travelpulse.com/news/destinations/caribbean-dominates-top-destinations-for-spring-break-2027)
- STS VIP Party Package events: Venues TBA [TBA]

Tour operators: STS Travel, StudentCity

Note: In 2026 STS ran a month-long 'Bahamas Beach Bash' at Breezes.

## Where to stay

- Breezes Resort & Spa (Cable Beach): STS Travel's 2027 spring break base.
- Atlantis on Paradise Island: resort, casino and waterpark (day passes available).
- Cable Beach resorts near the casino.

## Nightlife

- Club Waterloo: a huge club with a maze of rooms.
- Aura (Atlantis) and Bond: VIP nights on tour-operator schedules.
- Señor Frog's on the harbor.
- Clubs open late. Go on nights when tour operators schedule events to skip cover and lines.

## Days out

- Blue Lagoon Island: swim with dolphins and snorkel with stingrays.
- Spring break party cruises.
- Historic Nassau: Fort Fincastle, the Queen's Staircase and the Bay Street straw market.

## Getting around

- Daytime jitney buses are cheap. At night, use taxis and agree on the fare first.
- Expect a bridge toll to Paradise Island and 15% service charges on some bills.
- Wear a cover-up away from the beach or pool.

## FAQ

### Is Nassau / Bahamas a good spring break destination for 2027?

Nassau / Bahamas scored 83/100 (#3 of 21, "Hot") in our Spring Break 2026 popularity rating, based on visitation, search buzz and college crowds. A short flight from the U.S. East Coast with pirate history, Paradise Island's mega-resort and party cruises. The Bahamas set a record with about 1.42 million visitors in March 2026.

### What airport do you fly into for Nassau / Bahamas?

Fly into NAS.

### What is the drinking age in Nassau / Bahamas?

The drinking age is 18.

### Which tour companies offer Spring Break 2027 trips to Nassau / Bahamas?

STS Travel, StudentCity offer trips to Nassau / Bahamas. Compare out-the-door prices, party packages and refund policies before booking.

### What's happening in Nassau / Bahamas for Spring Break 2027?

STS Travel Nassau trips (start early March) (Mar 2027).

### When is spring break 2027?

Most college spring breaks in 2027 fall between March 6 and March 28. Easter is March 28, 2027, which makes the season early and compressed.

# South Padre Island Spring Break 2027 Guide

> A "two-nation vacation" on the tip of the longest barrier island in the U.S., about 40 minutes from Mexico. South Padre is Texas' spring break capital, and Texas Week brings the biggest crowds.

URL: https://springbreak.com/destinations/spi.html
Location: Texas, USA
Updated: 2026-11-11
2027 status: partly announced

## Key facts

- Fly into: BRO (Brownsville) or HRL (Harlingen)
- Drinking age: 21
- Peak: Spring Break Texas Week (mid-March)

## 2026 popularity rating

Score: 80/100 (rank #4 of 21; visitation 3.5/5, search & social buzz 4/5, spring-break crowd 4.5/5; medium confidence)

- Spring Break Texas Week ran Mar 14–22, 2026, with thousands of visitors reported on the beach (source: https://www.krgv.com/news/visitors-notice-more-trash-on-the-beach-as-thousands-flock-to-south-padre-island-for-spring-break)
- Top domestic spring break search in 5 states (source: https://upgradedpoints.com/news/top-searched-spring-break-locations-2026/)
- One island restaurant reported business down 15–20% YoY (source: https://www.krgv.com/news/south-padre-island-restaurant-sees-decrease-in-spring-break-customers)

## 2027 events and packages

- Clayton's spring break concert lineup: TBA (usually announced Dec–Jan) [TBA]

Tour operators: Inertia Tours

Note: Inertia Tours is based on the island. Past Clayton's headliners include Ice Spice (2025).

## Where to stay

- Isla Grand Beach Resort (Padre Blvd): long the event hub, with daytime and evening pool parties.
- Condos are the island's best value. Tour operators such as Inertia Tours block-book condos and rooms.
- Book early and look for kitchens or a microwave and refrigerator.

## Nightlife

- Clayton's Beach Bar (Padre Blvd): the island's biggest concert venue, with rap and EDM headliners each March.
- Louie's Backyard (Laguna Blvd): bayside DJ nights.
- Tequila Frogs: a club overlooking the Laguna Madre.
- About ten nightspots in all, most within a short shuttle ride.

## Days on the island

- Public Gulf beaches with a long-standing party scene.
- Windsurfing, kiteboarding and sailing on the calm Laguna Madre.
- Padre Island National Seashore to the north for wilder beaches.

## Getting around and tips

- Island Metro runs a free shuttle up and down the island during the day.
- Beach Reach volunteers have offered free late-night rides during spring break.
- Texas DPS has urged spring breakers not to cross into Mexico. Check current advisories before any border trip.
- Party cards such as the Maniac VIP Card cover entry to partner events.

## FAQ

### Is South Padre Island a good spring break destination for 2027?

South Padre Island scored 80/100 (#4 of 21, "Hot") in our Spring Break 2026 popularity rating, based on visitation, search buzz and college crowds. A "two-nation vacation" on the tip of the longest barrier island in the U.S., about 40 minutes from Mexico. South Padre is Texas' spring break capital, and Texas Week brings the biggest crowds.

### What airport do you fly into for South Padre Island?

Fly into BRO (Brownsville) or HRL (Harlingen).

### What is the drinking age in South Padre Island?

The drinking age is 21.

### Which tour companies offer Spring Break 2027 trips to South Padre Island?

Inertia Tours offers trips to South Padre Island. Compare out-the-door prices, party packages and refund policies before booking.

### What's happening in South Padre Island for Spring Break 2027?

No 2027 spring break events have been announced for South Padre Island yet. Lineups are usually announced in December and January.

### When is spring break 2027?

Most college spring breaks in 2027 fall between March 6 and March 28. Easter is March 28, 2027, which makes the season early and compressed.

# Cabo San Lucas Spring Break 2027 Guide

> At the tip of Baja, Cabo San Lucas earned the nickname "Cabo San Loco": desert-meets-ocean scenery, Medano Beach day clubs and a compact downtown nightlife district.

URL: https://springbreak.com/destinations/cabo.html
Location: Baja California Sur, Mexico
Updated: 2026-11-11
2027 status: confirmed for 2027

## Key facts

- Fly into: SJD (San José del Cabo)
- Drinking age: 18
- 2026 rank: #2 intl. (Allianz)

## 2026 popularity rating

Score: 80/100 (rank #5 of 21; visitation 4.5/5, search & social buzz 3.5/5, spring-break crowd 4/5; medium confidence)

- San José del Cabo ranked #2 international destination in Allianz's data (source: https://www.allianzworldwidepartners.com/media-center/press-releases/Allianz-Partners-reveals-travelers-are-ready-for-beaches-cities-and-peace-of-mind-this-spring-break.html)
- STS named it a top destination for 2027 (source: https://www.travelpulse.com/news/destinations/caribbean-dominates-top-destinations-for-spring-break-2027)

## 2027 events and packages

Tour operators: STS Travel, Inertia Tours, StudentCity

Note: Inertia's 2025 Cabo prices were $899–$1,299 per person, flights extra. 2027 prices are TBA.

## Nightlife

- El Squid Roe: a three-story downtown institution with a big sound system, dancing on every level and a decades-long spring break reputation.
- Cabo Wabo Cantina: live music daily, near the marina.
- The Giggling Marlin and Happy Ending Cantina are classic downtown bars.
- Mango Deck on Medano Beach: the place to start the day, with live music, contests and views of the arch.

## Where to stay

- Student packages center on resorts such as RIU Santa Fe and Corazón Cabo on Medano Beach.
- STS Travel, StudentCity and Inertia Tours all sell Cabo trips.

## Days out

- A boat or water taxi to El Arco and Lover's Beach.
- Booze cruises and sunset sails around Land's End.
- Snorkeling at Pelican Rock, and whale watching through early spring.

## Tips

- The Pacific side has strong currents, so swim at Medano Beach.
- Use authorized airport transportation and agree on taxi prices first.

# Miami & South Beach Spring Break 2027 Guide

> Art Deco streets, sidewalk cafes and nightlife until dawn, plus Miami Music Week and Ultra at the end of March. Miami Beach now actively discourages spring break crowds, so expect tighter rules than anywhere else in Florida.

URL: https://springbreak.com/destinations/miami.html
Location: Florida, USA
Updated: 2026-11-11
2027 status: confirmed for 2027

## Key facts

- Fly into: MIA or FLL
- Big event: Ultra · Mar 26–28, 2027
- Best for: Music lovers (21+)

## 2026 popularity rating

Score: 73/100 (rank #6 of 21; visitation 4.5/5, search & social buzz 4/5, spring-break crowd 2.5/5; high confidence)

- #3 domestic spring break booking on AAA's list (source: https://lodgingmagazine.com/aaa-names-top-destinations-for-spring-break/)
- Arrests in the South Beach district fell ~24% and crowds were smaller than the post-pandemic years (source: https://www.axios.com/local/miami/2026/04/15/miami-beach-spring-break-business-arrests)
- Miami Music Week and Ultra kept search buzz high

## 2027 events and packages

- Miami Music Week: Mar 22–28, 2027 [confirmed for 2027] (source: https://www.miamiandbeaches.com/events/miami-music-week-guide)
- Winter Music Conference: Mar 24–26, 2027 [confirmed for 2027] (source: https://www.edmtunes.com/2026/06/winter-music-conference-announce-2027-dates/amp/)
- Ultra Music Festival: Calvin Harris, Armin van Buuren, Dom Dolla, Martin Garrix, Marshmello, Mau P, Indira Paganotto, Boys Noize, Sofi Tukker's Animal Talk, Drumcode: Mar 26–28, 2027 [confirmed for 2027] (source: https://ultramusicfestival.com/tickets/miami/)

Note: Miami Beach eased its spring break crackdown in 2026 (no automatic curfew), but the city still says it has 'broken up' with spring break. 2027 rules are usually announced in February.

## Where to stay

- Hotels and condos line Collins Avenue, many directly on the beach.
- Timeshare units such as Westgate Miami Beach come with kitchens. Renting from private owners can cost far less than resort rates.
- Staying in downtown Miami or Brickell puts you close to Ultra at Bayfront Park.

## Music and nightlife

- Miami Music Week (Mar 22–28) fills clubs and hotel pool decks with DJ showcases.
- Ultra Music Festival (Mar 26–28, Bayfront Park) closes out the week. Calvin Harris headlines the 2027 Phase 1 lineup.
- Ocean Drive and Washington Avenue are the classic South Beach strips. Most clubs are 21+.

## Days on the beach

- South Beach's lifeguard towers and Lummus Park are the iconic stretch.
- Walk the Art Deco Historic District and Española Way.
- Hotel pool parties during Miami Music Week are the daytime highlight.

## Rules and tips

- Miami Beach's "break up with spring break" campaign has brought parking restrictions, DUI checkpoints, bag checks and curfews it can impose if needed.
- Glass is not allowed on the beach, and open containers are banned in public areas.
- Budget more than at Gulf Coast beaches: rooms and drinks cost more.

> A road trip away for students in Arizona, Nevada and California. Spring break in Vegas means dayclubs, pool parties and huge resorts, and almost all of the nightlife is 21+.

- Casino buffets, food courts and In-N-Out keep costs down.

# Lake Havasu Spring Break 2027 Guide

> The West's biggest spring break happens on the water. Lake Havasu is all about boat parties on the Colorado River, the sandbar and Copper Canyon.

URL: https://springbreak.com/destinations/havasu.html
Location: Arizona, USA
Updated: 2026-11-11
2027 status: TBA

## Key facts

- Fly into: LAS or PHX, then drive
- Must-have: A boat
- Peak: Early–mid March

## 2026 popularity rating

Score: 70/100 (rank #8 of 21; visitation 3/5, search & social buzz 3.5/5, spring-break crowd 4/5; low confidence)

- Top-searched domestic spring break spot in Arizona, California and Nevada (source: https://upgradedpoints.com/news/top-searched-spring-break-locations-2026/)
- No official 2026 visitor count was published

## 2027 events and packages

- Spring break calendar: TBA [TBA]

Note: Official guide: havasuspringbreak.com. Boating is the main draw.

## On the water

- Bridgewater Channel, under the London Bridge, is the main gathering spot for boats.
- Copper Canyon and the sandbar are the party coves, and most are only reachable by boat.
- Boat rentals start around $300+ per day. Windsor Beach in Lake Havasu State Park has rentals.

## Where to stay

- London Bridge Resort: condo rentals right on Bridgewater Channel.
- Hotels and vacation rentals around the channel book up fast in March.

## Nightlife and sights

- Kokomo: the biggest nightclub on the channel.
- The London Bridge itself, rebuilt here in 1971.
- Parker Dam, downstream on the Colorado River.

# Panama City Beach Spring Break 2027 Guide

> More than 27 miles of white-sand Gulf beach, moderate prices and big beachfront clubs. MTV made Panama City Beach the default U.S. spring break, and it still draws huge college crowds every March.

URL: https://springbreak.com/destinations/pcb.html
Location: Florida, USA
Updated: 2026-11-11
2027 status: partly announced

## Key facts

- Fly into: ECP (Northwest Florida Beaches)
- Drinking age: 21 (most clubs admit 18+)
- Best for: Drive-in college crowds

## 2026 popularity rating

Score: 63/100 (rank #9 of 21; visitation 3/5, search & social buzz 3/5, spring-break crowd 3.5/5; low confidence)

- No verified 2026 bed-tax or visitor figures yet
- Tourism marketing now targets families rather than college groups (source: https://www.yahoo.com/news/tourism-officials-prepare-upcoming-spring-002412053.html)
- Was not a state leader in the 2026 Google search study (source: https://upgradedpoints.com/news/top-searched-spring-break-locations-2026/)

## 2027 events and packages

- Spring break concert series: TBA [TBA]
- Gulf Coast Jam (country festival, after the season): Jun 3–6, 2027 [confirmed for 2027] (source: https://www.ticketnews.com/2026/10/gulf-coast-jam-reveals-full-2027-lineup-led-by-luke-bryan-jason-aldean-and-zach-top)

Note: In past years the springbreak.com page ran foam parties and DJ sets at the Holiday Inn Resort. No 2027 spring break shows have been announced.

## Where to stay

- Holiday Inn Resort Panama City Beach: long known as "Spring Break Central," with a beachside stage and daytime events on the west end.
- Beachfront condos and hotels along Front Beach Road. Rooms with kitchens go first, so book early.
- Tour operators block-book hotels and condos, which often include party passes.

## Nightlife

- Harpoon Harry's Beach Club (Front Beach Rd): the main day-and-night venue for sponsored concerts, foam parties and DJ sets.
- Hammerhead Fred's (Thomas Dr): a classic club known for foam and glow-paint parties.
- Longboards (Thomas Dr): DJ nights.
- Sharky's Beach Club and Coyote Ugly Saloon: two of the biggest student bars on the beach.

## Days on the beach

- The Gulf is calm and flat, so think jet skis, parasailing and sailboats rather than surfing.
- Sponsored brand events pop up on the beach behind the big hotels.
- St. Andrews State Park and Shell Island are good for a quieter day.

## Rules and tips

- During March, alcohol is banned on the beach and in commercial parking lots, and glass is never allowed on the sand.
- Late-night alcohol sales are restricted during spring break, and some beach access points have had night closures. Check the city's 2027 rules in February.
- Party cards such as the Maniac Party Card bundle cover charges and drink specials at partner clubs.

More than 27 miles of white-sand Gulf beach, moderate prices and big beachfront clubs. MTV made Panama City Beach the default U.S. spring break, and it still draws huge college crowds every March.

Fly into ECP (Northwest Florida Beaches).

The drinking age is 21 (most clubs admit 18+).

Gulf Coast Jam (country festival, after the season) (Jun 3–6, 2027).

# Ft. Lauderdale Spring Break 2027 Guide

> The original spring break town, made famous by Where the Boys Are in 1960. Today it's calmer and more polished, with the beachfront Strip, Las Olas and a riverfront nightlife district.

URL: https://springbreak.com/destinations/ftl.html
Location: Florida, USA
Updated: 2026-11-11
2027 status: TBA

- Fly into: FLL
- Drinking age: 21 (clubs often 18+)
- Best for: History and a calmer scene

- #2 domestic spring break booking on AAA's list, mostly families and general travelers (source: https://lodgingmagazine.com/aaa-names-top-destinations-for-spring-break/)
- 47 beach arrests reported early in the season, a modest number (source: https://www.foxnews.com/us/spring-break-crackdown-cuts-arrests-hot-spot-while-chaos-spreads-other-party-hubs)

## 2027 events and packages

- City events and rules: TBA [TBA]

Note: The 2026 season brought more police on the beach and downtown, plus curfews for under-18s.

## Where to go

- The Strip: A1A along the beach from Las Olas Blvd north to Sunrise Blvd.
- Las Olas Boulevard: upscale shops and restaurants to the east, newer clubs to the west.
- Riverwalk along the New River for waterfront bars.

## Nightlife

- Elbo Room: the oldest spring break bar in town, right across from the beach and featured in Where the Boys Are.
- Rock Bar (Fort Lauderdale Beach Blvd): daily pool parties in March.
- SW 2nd Street (Himmarshee/Cooley Hammock area): bars and clubs after dark.

## Rules and tips

- Alcohol is prohibited on the beach.
- Expect a heavy police presence on the beach and downtown, plus curfews for under-18s.
- Ocean Rescue posts beach-flag conditions daily. Swim near lifeguards.

> On Mexico's Pacific coast, Puerto Vallarta is more relaxed than Cancun: cobblestone streets, the Malecón boardwalk, art galleries and several Cancun-brand clubs. It's popular with students from western universities.

URL: https://springbreak.com/destinations/pv.html
Location: Jalisco, Mexico
Updated: 2026-11-11

- Drinking age: 18

- The Vamar Vallarta: inside Marina Vallarta, about 5 minutes from the airport.
- Riu Vallarta and Krystal Beach Resort: all-inclusives that draw student crowds.
- StudentCity, STS and Inertia Tours have sold packages to these resorts.

## Nightlife

- Mandala Beach Club, La Vaquita and Señor Frog's: Cancun-brand clubs on and around the Malecón.
- La Santa: an open-air club with a big dance floor.
- Chicabal Beach Club: an upscale beach club on the Pacific.
- The Jungle Bar (Old Town) and Roxy Rockhouse for live music.

## Days out

- Snorkeling, ziplining and boat trips around Banderas Bay.
- The Malecón, historic center and local markets.
- March is ideal, with sunny days and cool evenings.

## Budget

- Operator all-inclusive packages (flights, hotel, meals, party package) have run about $1,200–$2,000.
- Booking flights, hotel and a party package yourself has run about $800–$1,000.

- Use the buddy system at night.

# Spring Break 2027 Dates: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> Easter falls on March 28 in 2027, so the season is compressed: most college breaks land between March 6 and March 28.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/dates.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key facts

- Peak window: Mar 6–28, 2027
- Easter Sunday: Mar 28, 2027
- Ultra Miami: Mar 26–28, 2027

## How the 2027 calendar shapes up

Most schools schedule spring break in one of four March weeks. Because Easter is early in 2027, schools that tie break to Easter week will travel at the very end of March, the same weekend as Ultra in Miami.

Texas schools usually share one week (South Padre Island called it "Spring Break Texas Week" in 2026, Mar 14–22). Expect the island's busiest week of 2027 to fall around the same mid-March dates.

## Week by week

- Week of Mar 6: early-break schools, plus quieter beaches and better hotel rates.
- Week of Mar 13: Texas and many Southern and Midwestern schools. South Padre and Panama City Beach peak.
- Week of Mar 20: Big Ten, many Northeastern schools and Miami Music Week (Mar 22–28).
- Week of Mar 27: Easter-week schools and Ultra weekend (Mar 26–28).

## Planning tips

- Confirm your school's official academic calendar before you put down a deposit.
- Fly midweek. Saturday and Sunday departures are the most expensive in peak weeks.
- If your group's breaks don't line up, the week of Mar 20 usually catches the most schools.

## Videos

- StudentCity South Padre Island, Texas Spring Break (StudentCity Videos): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CqS8uX5enpU
- SPRING BREAK IN PANAMA CITY BEACH! *first college spring break* (Lilly Burke): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gu-fBUzE7is

# Concerts & Festivals: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> Miami owns the last week of March: Miami Music Week runs Mar 22–28 and Ultra closes it out Mar 26–28 at Bayfront Park. Beach-town concert lineups are usually announced in December and January.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/concerts.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key facts

- Ultra Miami: Mar 26–28 · Bayfront Park
- Miami Music Week: Mar 22–28
- Winter Music Conference: Mar 24–26

## Ultra Music Festival 2027

The 27th edition has announced its Phase 1 lineup, led by Calvin Harris. Other names reported so far include Armin van Buuren, Dom Dolla, Martin Garrix, Marshmello, Mau P, Indira Paganotto, Boys Noize and Liquid Stranger. Sofi Tukker's Animal Talk and Adam Beyer's Drumcode are hosting stage takeovers. More phases are expected before March.

## Where else to see shows

- South Padre Island: Clayton's Beach Bar hosts the island's biggest spring break concerts. Past headliners include Ice Spice (2025).
- Panama City Beach: concerts at beachfront clubs. Gulf Coast Jam (June 3–6) comes after spring break season.
- Cancun: Coco Bongo's nightly shows, plus day parties at Mandala Beach and other clubs, often included in party packages.
- Las Vegas: Dayclub and nightclub residencies at Drai's, Marquee and Wet Republic (21+).

## Ticket tips

- Buy festival passes from the official site or authorized resellers only.
- Party-package wristbands from tour companies often include cover at partner clubs. Check which nights are included.
- Most U.S. venues are 21+ for entry or drinking. Check before you buy.

# Spring Break 101: Packages: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> A spring break package bundles your room, transfers and often a party schedule. Knowing what's included is the difference between a deal and a surprise bill.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/packages.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key facts

- All-inclusive: Room, meals and drinks
- Party package: Club cover and events
- VIP pass: Open bars and line-skips

## The main package types

- All-inclusive: hotel, meals and drinks at the resort. Most Mexico and Caribbean student trips are built this way.
- Hotel-only: the cheapest option, where you buy food and nightlife yourself. STS Travel's 2027 Las Vegas trip is hotel-only.
- Air + hotel: adds round-trip flights from your nearest airport, usually with airport transfers.
- Party package or VIP pass: an add-on that covers cover charges, open-bar events, booze cruises and headliner shows.

## What the big companies offer

- StudentCity: Cancun, Punta Cana, Cabo and Nassau, with a Party Package for headline events and club nights.
- STS Travel: Cancun, Cabo, Punta Cana, Nassau, Montego Bay, Riviera Maya and, new for 2027, Guanacaste, Costa Rica. VIP Party Package optional.
- Inertia Tours: a South Padre Island specialist that also offers Cancun (three resort tiers) and Cabo.

## Before you book

- Ask whether taxes, resort fees and transfers are included in the quoted price.
- Read the deposit and refund policy, and consider travel insurance.
- Party packages lock you into a set schedule of clubs. That's great if you want those clubs, and a waste if you don't.

- 2015 Inception Music Festival Aftermovie | StudentCity Cancun Spring Break (StudentCity Videos): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xyf6xD07k3g

# U.S. Price Guide: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> Driving to a U.S. beach is still the cheapest spring break. What you pay depends on when you go and how many people share a room.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/prices-us.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key facts

- Cheapest week: Week of Mar 6
- Biggest saver: Condo split 4–6 ways
- Biggest cost: Peak-week lodging

## Where the money goes

- Lodging is usually 40–60% of the trip. Prices jump during each destination's peak week.
- Party passes and concert tickets: South Padre and Panama City Beach clubs sell multi-day passes.
- Food and drinks: groceries for a condo kitchen cut costs a lot.
- Transportation: gas and parking for drive-in beaches, or airfare plus rideshares for Miami and Las Vegas.

## Destination snapshot

- South Padre Island and Panama City Beach: condo-heavy and drivable for large parts of Texas and the Southeast, so usually the best value.
- Miami and Ft. Lauderdale: pricier hotels, and Miami Music Week and Ultra (Mar 22–28) push rates higher.
- Las Vegas: midweek rooms can be cheap, but club and show costs add up. Most nightlife is 21+.
- Daytona and Lake Havasu: lower-key and budget-friendly. Havasu is built around boat rentals.

## Saving money

- Book early in the season. Cancellable rates protect you if plans change.
- Travel a week before or after your destination's peak week.
- Use the prompt link above for live 2027 price ranges by destination.

- Planning SOUTH PADRE ISLAND in 2026? | What to Know BEFORE You Go! (Destination Do's): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OY82RUYjWok
- South Padre Island Spring Break 2026 (Julia Mikkelsen): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zMaFwLBa_GE

# Mexico & Caribbean Price Guide: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> Mexico and the Caribbean cost more upfront, but all-inclusive pricing makes the total predictable: one price covers room, meals and drinks.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/prices-mx.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

- Punta Cana (7 nights): From $2,791 per person, Mar 21–28
- Top 2027 picks: Cancun, Cabo, Punta Cana, Nassau

## What the package price covers

- All-inclusive resort stay, meals and drinks.
- Airport transfers, plus flights if you choose an air package.
- Taxes and fees vary by operator. Ask for the out-the-door price.
- Party packages are usually a separate add-on.

## Known 2027 data points

- Inertia Tours' Cabo trips ran $899–$1,299 per person all-inclusive without flights in 2025. 2027 prices are TBA.
- Fox World Travel lists a 7-night all-inclusive Punta Cana trip for Mar 21–28, 2027 starting at $2,791 per person.
- STS Travel names Cancun, Cabo, Punta Cana and Nassau its top destinations for 2027.

## Hidden costs to budget for

- Tips for resort staff, excursions and boat parties.
- Departure or tourist taxes, which are sometimes collected on arrival.
- Travel insurance and a passport (see Passports & Travel Docs).

# Passports & Travel Docs: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> If you're flying to Mexico or the Caribbean in March 2027, you need a passport book. Apply early: spring is peak season for passport applications.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/passports.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key facts

- Air travel abroad: Passport book required
- Domestic flights: REAL ID or passport
- Closed-loop cruise: Birth certificate + photo ID OK

## Which document you need

- International flights (Mexico, Dominican Republic, Bahamas, Jamaica, Costa Rica): a U.S. passport book. The passport card is not valid for international air travel.
- Domestic flights: a REAL ID–compliant license or another TSA-accepted ID such as a passport. REAL ID has been enforced since May 7, 2025.
- Closed-loop cruises (starting and ending at the same U.S. port): U.S. citizens can usually travel with a birth certificate and government photo ID, though a passport is strongly recommended.

## How to apply

- First-time applicants apply in person with Form DS-11, proof of citizenship, ID and a photo.
- Eligible adults can renew by mail or online.
- Processing times change through the year. Check travel.state.gov, and pay for expedited service if your trip is within a couple of months.

## Don't get turned back

- Make sure your passport is valid for your whole trip. Some countries and airlines want extra validity.
- Your name must match exactly across your passport, ticket and booking.
- Take a photo of your passport and keep a copy separate from the original.

## Videos

- How to Apply for a U.S. Passport: Step-by-Step Guide (eForms): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=417nYMQaUE8
- Get Your U.S. Passport FAST | Quick Guide (Renewals & Applications) (Away Together w/ Nik and Allie): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uU0NQ3IaqAo

# Safety & Local Rules: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> Spring break 2026 showed both sides: Miami Beach was calmer than in years, while Daytona Beach logged 75 arrests in one weekend. Know the local rules before you go.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/safety.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key facts

- U.S. drinking age: 21
- Mexico / Caribbean: 18
- Beach flags: Red = high hazard

## Local rules to expect

- Miami Beach: in 2026, arrests fell about 24% in the South Beach district. The city still uses parking limits, bag checks and a curfew it can impose if needed.
- Ft. Lauderdale and Daytona Beach: heavier police presence and curfews for under-18s in 2026.
- Many Florida beaches ban alcohol, glass containers and tents during spring break.
- City rules for 2027 are usually announced in February. Check the official city websites.

## Beach and water safety

- Florida beach flags: green means low hazard, yellow medium, red high, double red closes the water, and purple warns of dangerous marine life.
- If a rip current pulls you out, swim parallel to shore until you're free, then swim back in.
- Swim near a lifeguard tower and never swim alone or impaired.

## Personal safety

- Use the buddy system, and agree on a meeting spot and check-in times.
- Watch your drink and never leave it unattended.
- Use official taxis or rideshares, and confirm the license plate before you get in.
- Check the U.S. State Department's travel advisory for your destination, and sign up for STEP alerts.

## Videos

- WATCH | Safety tips for students traveling during spring break (WKYT): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pJgu20kZztc
- Security Expert Shows How College Students Can Stay Safe (Inside Edition): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=itRHv2Vwykc
- How to keep your teens safe when traveling for spring break (TODAY): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HpPtsG33tIY

# Spring Break Cruises: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> A 3–5 night cruise to the Bahamas or Mexico bundles transport, room, food and entertainment, and lets you visit two or three ports in one week.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/cruises.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key facts

- Typical length: 3–5 nights
- Popular ports: Nassau, Cozumel, private islands
- Drinking age: 21 on U.S. sailings

## Where they sail from

- Miami and Ft. Lauderdale: the most short Bahamas sailings, often calling at Nassau and a cruise-line private island.
- Port Canaveral and Tampa: Bahamas and western Caribbean itineraries.
- Galveston: western Caribbean and Mexico itineraries, often within driving distance for Texas students.

## Rules for college travelers

- Most major lines require at least one guest in each cabin to be 21 or older. Check your line's age policy before booking.
- The drinking age on sailings from U.S. ports is 21.
- Closed-loop cruises allow a birth certificate and photo ID, but a passport lets you fly home if you miss the ship.

## Booking tips

- Prices rise as sailings fill. Spring break weeks often sell out early.
- Drink packages, Wi-Fi, gratuities and excursions are extra.
- Get to the port the day before so a flight delay can't make you miss the ship.

- #1 overall (Allianz 2026): Orlando
- Most-searched domestic: Key West (17 states)

## Where families went in 2026

- Orlando was the #1 domestic spring break destination in Allianz's analysis of 1.3 million itineraries.
- Key West was the top-searched domestic spring break spot in 17 states, and Destin led in 15 states.
- Google Flights' biggest year-over-year search jumps were Hilo (Hawaii), Asheville (NC) and Sarasota (FL).

## Calmer beach picks

- Siesta Key and Sarasota: soft white sand and a calm Gulf.
- Clearwater Beach: Pier 60's nightly sunset celebration and easy walking.
- Destin and the 30A coast: emerald water and lots of condos.
- Riviera Maya: resort-based and quieter than Cancun's Hotel Zone.

## Family travel tips

- Avoid the college peak week at destinations like South Padre and Panama City Beach.
- Look for kids-stay-free and kids-eat-free resort deals.
- Children need their own passport for international flights.

# Packing & Gear: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> Pack light, pack smart. Most spring break trips need one carry-on and a beach bag.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/gear.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key facts

- Bag: 1 carry-on + personal item
- Must-have: Reef-safe sunscreen
- Don't forget: Passport / REAL ID

## Documents and money

- Passport book (international) or REAL ID (domestic flights).
- Copies of your passport, booking confirmations and insurance.
- A debit card with no foreign transaction fees, plus some cash in small bills.

## Beach and pool

- Reef-safe, mineral sunscreen. Some Mexican eco-parks and marine areas require biodegradable sunscreen.
- Two or three swimsuits, a cover-up, sunglasses and a hat.
- A refillable water bottle, aloe and a waterproof phone pouch.
- Sandals plus one pair of closed-toe shoes for clubs that require them.

## Tech and extras

- A portable charger, plus a universal adapter if needed (Mexico and most of the Caribbean use U.S. plugs).
- Wristbands and lanyards from party packages, so don't lose them.
- Budget airlines charge for carry-ons, so check bag rules before you pack.

# Spring Break Films: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> Spring break became a pop-culture event thanks to Hollywood, starting with a 1960 film set on Fort Lauderdale's beach.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/films.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key facts

- The original: Where the Boys Are (1960)
- The cult classic: Spring Breakers (2012)
- The setting: Fort Lauderdale

## The classics

- Where the Boys Are (1960): MGM's film about four college women on spring break in Fort Lauderdale. Connie Francis sang the title song, and it sent thousands of students south.
- Palm Springs Weekend (1963): the West Coast answer, with Troy Donahue and Connie Stevens.
- Where the Boys Are '84 (1984): a remake for the MTV era.
- Spring Break (1983): a Fort Lauderdale comedy from the height of the craze.

## Modern spring break on screen

- From Justin to Kelly (2003): an American Idol musical set in Miami.
- Piranha 3D (2010): spring break meets horror at a lake party.
- Spring Breakers (2012): Harmony Korine's neon-soaked crime film, shot in St. Petersburg, Florida.

# History of Spring Break: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> Spring break began with college swim teams training in Fort Lauderdale in the 1930s. It grew into a mass migration that has moved from city to city ever since.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/history.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key facts

- Origin: 1930s Fort Lauderdale
- Peak FTL crowds: ~350,000 (1985)
- Today's #1: Cancun

## From swim meets to beach parties

In the mid-1930s, college swim coaches began bringing their teams to Fort Lauderdale's Casino Pool each spring to train. Classmates followed, and the city's beaches became an annual gathering place.

Glendon Swarthout's 1960 novel Where the Boys Are and its film adaptation turned the trip into a national ritual. By the mid-1980s, Fort Lauderdale was drawing an estimated 350,000 students a year.

## The great migration

- 1985–1990s: Fort Lauderdale cracked down and Florida raised its drinking age to 21, so crowds moved to Daytona Beach and, later, Panama City Beach.
- 1986 onward: MTV's Spring Break broadcasts made Daytona and other beaches into TV events.
- 1990s–2000s: South Padre Island became Texas' spring break capital, and Cancun rose to #1 internationally.
- 2020s: Miami Beach "broke up" with spring break, Daytona's police chief said the city should stop marketing itself, and Caribbean all-inclusives such as Punta Cana and Nassau surged.

## What's next for 2027

Tour operators are adding adventure-focused trips like Guanacaste, Costa Rica, while the classic party destinations, Cancun, Punta Cana and South Padre Island, remain the most popular.

- Spring Break 1967 Ft. Lauderdale Florida Archival Newsreel PublicDomainFootage.com (PublicDomainFootage): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-7Ml7jbXYFY
- History of Spring Break (virtualhistory360): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iYS8fUd98ow
- The Rise and Fall of Spring Break's Capital: Fort Lauderdale, Florida (Paul McAllister): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6SalRd4y-TE

# Contests & Sweepstakes: Spring Break 2027 Guide

> Free trips are real, but they come from trip-leader programs and official sweepstakes, not from DMs asking you to pay a fee.

URL: https://springbreak.com/topics/contests.html
Updated: 2026-11-11

## Key facts

- Best route: Trip-leader / campus rep programs
- Red flag: Pay to claim a prize
- Always check: Official rules page

## How students earn free trips

- Trip leaders and campus reps: tour companies often give a free or discounted trip to whoever organizes a group of travelers.
- Brand sweepstakes: beverage, apparel and travel brands run spring break giveaways each winter.
- Campus and alumni raffles: student organizations sometimes raffle trips as fundraisers.

## Spotting scams

- A legitimate prize never asks you to pay a fee, tax deposit or processing charge upfront.
- Check that the sweepstakes has official rules with a sponsor name, address, eligibility rules and an end date.
- Book only through the company's official website or phone number, never through links in unsolicited messages.
